hunks.baseline: My mother was wearing an apron with the restaurant’s name printed on it and a pair of rubber gloves smeared with grease.
hunks.sol: She wore an apron printed with the restaurant’s name and rubber gloves smeared with grease.

hunks.baseline: Her surprised expression soon turned to bewilderment.
hunks.sol: Her surprise quickly turned to bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: I gave my flustered mother a broad grin. That was when a shrill voice pierced my ear.
hunks.sol: I flashed my flustered mother a broad grin. Just then, a shrill voice pierced my ear.

hunks.baseline: “So you’re the son of Kim ajumma[^2]?”
hunks.sol: “So you’re Kim ajumma’s[^1] son?”

hunks.baseline: A middle-aged woman was looking me over warily.
hunks.sol: A middle-aged woman looked me over warily.

hunks.baseline: There was no need to ask who she was or what she did. I already knew.
hunks.sol: There was no need to ask who she was or what she did. I already knew exactly who she was.

hunks.baseline: The owner gave an unnecessary cough after seeing me bow politely from the waist.
hunks.sol: The owner cleared her throat awkwardly when I bowed politely at the waist.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe it’s because you’re young, but you’re awfully thoughtless. If someone showed up out of the blue like this, how would you feel if you were the owner?”
hunks.sol: “Maybe it’s because you’re young, but you’re awfully thoughtless. If someone showed up out of the blue like this, how do you think the owner would feel?”

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. I suppose I’d be upset.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. I suppose you’d be upset.”

hunks.baseline: “And then an employee’s son suddenly shows up without saying a word? From your perspective, Boss, I can understand why you’d be upset. Completely.”
hunks.sol: “And then an employee’s son suddenly shows up without warning? From your perspective, Boss, I can understand why you’d be upset. Completely.”

hunks.baseline: *What the hell is this kid?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is with this kid?*

hunks.baseline: Ignoring her confused reaction, I grabbed my mother by the arm.
hunks.sol: Ignoring her confused reaction, I tugged my mother by the arm.

hunks.baseline: I asked with an innocent expression,
hunks.sol: I gave them an innocent look.

hunks.baseline: “What I said before was sincere. From your perspective, Boss, you had every right to feel that way. But…”
hunks.sol: “I meant every word. From your perspective, Boss, you have every right to feel that way. But…”

hunks.baseline: A heavy silence settled over the restaurant.
hunks.sol: A heavy silence descended.

hunks.baseline: My mother stared at me blankly, while the owner’s face turned dark red before she shrieked,
hunks.sol: My mother stared blankly at me, while the owner’s face turned dark red before she shrieked.

hunks.baseline: “Who said you could do that?!”
hunks.sol: “Who says she can quit?!”

hunks.baseline: “We did.”
hunks.sol: “We do.”

hunks.baseline: “Y-you!”
hunks.sol: “Y-you…!”

hunks.baseline: “T-three, three! F-four, four!”
hunks.sol: “Three, three! Four, four!”

hunks.baseline: “Hey, you fucking son of a bitch!”
hunks.sol: “You fucking son of a bitch!”

hunks.baseline: The hand she raised along with her vicious curse never reached its target.
hunks.sol: The hand she raised along with the vicious curse never reached its target.

hunks.baseline: Grab!
Someone caught the owner’s wrist in a single motion and glared at her.
hunks.sol: A hand shot out and caught the owner’s wrist.

hunks.baseline: My mother spat the words out with an aura fierce enough to make even a First Rate master flinch.
hunks.sol: My mother glared at her, radiating an aura fierce enough to make even a First Rate master flinch.

hunks.baseline: I had heard her swear once earlier in the dining area, but this was the first time in my life I had seen my mother curse like this. She never even spoke ill of other people in front of her children, and yet…
hunks.sol: I had heard her swear once earlier from the dining area, but this was the first time in my life I had ever seen my mother curse like this. She never even spoke ill of other people in front of her children, and yet…

hunks.baseline: The owner charged at my mother, but I stepped in front of her.
hunks.sol: The owner lunged at my mother, but I stepped between them.

hunks.baseline: The owner’s eyes rolled back as she began wildly swinging her arms with a scream.
hunks.sol: Her eyes rolled back, and she began flailing wildly with a shriek.

hunks.baseline: Of course, none of her attacks posed the slightest threat to me.
hunks.sol: Of course, none of it posed the slightest threat to me.

hunks.baseline: *Calling that an attack is embarrassing.*
hunks.sol: *It’s embarrassing to even call that an attack.*

hunks.baseline: Compared to the enemies I had faced in Gates and the Murim, her attacks were no more dangerous than the fluttering of a fly’s wings. With my bones, muscles, tendons, and ability to take a hit all dramatically enhanced, even a punch from an ordinary adult man would only tickle.
hunks.sol: Compared to the enemies I had faced inside Gates and in the Murim, it was no more dangerous than a fly beating its wings. Now that my bones and muscles, Sinews and Meridians, and Toughness had all improved dramatically, even a punch from an ordinary adult man would only tickle.

hunks.baseline: She was now in her fifties and morbidly obese; her body clearly had its limits.
hunks.sol: She was in her fifties and morbidly obese. Her body clearly had its limits.

hunks.baseline: “Huff, huff! You Hunter bastard, are you bullying a civilian?”
hunks.sol: “Huff, huff! You call yourself a Hunter, and you’re bullying a civilian?”

hunks.baseline: That she could come out with a line like that—I had to marvel at how the owner’s brain worked.
hunks.sol: That she could come out with a line like that—I had to marvel at how her mind worked.

hunks.baseline: “Can’t you see that I’m hurt? My fingernail broke and it’s bleeding!”
hunks.sol: “Can’t you see I’m hurt? My fingernail broke, and it’s bleeding!”

hunks.baseline: “You hurt yourself hitting me. I’ve just been standing here, so why are you shaking all by yourself?”
hunks.sol: “You hurt yourself hitting me. I’ve just been standing here, so why are you trembling all by yourself?”

hunks.baseline: I glanced around. The kitchen employees, along with the customers in the dining area, were watching the owner’s stand-up routine with exhausted expressions.
hunks.sol: I glanced around. The kitchen staff and the customers in the dining area were all watching the owner’s stand-up routine with disgusted expressions.

hunks.baseline: “If you can’t accept what happened, call the police. There must be about fifty witnesses here, so that should work out nicely.”
hunks.sol: “If you can’t accept what happened, call the police. There must be about fifty witnesses here, so that works out nicely.”

hunks.baseline: “Not going to call? Since you were injured and bled because of a Hunter, you should go to the police station, give a statement, file a complaint, and hire a lawyer. You’ll be busy starting tomorrow.”
hunks.sol: “Not going to call? Since a Hunter injured you and made you bleed, you should go to the police station, give a statement, file a complaint, and hire a lawyer. You’ll be busy starting tomorrow.”

hunks.baseline: I had intended to tease her a little longer, but the more we talked, the more I felt my time slipping away. I clicked my tongue.
hunks.sol: I had intended to tease her a little longer, but the more we talked, the more I felt I was wasting my time. I clicked my tongue.

hunks.baseline: “What are you, the mayor? You’re only the owner. Don’t make everyone around you miserable, and try to have a better attitude. We’re leaving.”
hunks.sol: “What are you, the mayor? You’re just the owner. Stop making everyone around you miserable and try being a better person. We’re leaving.”

hunks.baseline: I was about to turn around when the owner, her face twisted with resentment, crooked her lips.
hunks.sol: I was about to turn away when the corners of the owner’s mouth twisted with resentment.

hunks.baseline: “Would it mean anything if I told you?”
hunks.sol: “Would you know it if I told you?”

hunks.baseline: “My son would know. Our Minsu is a Hunter in Bucheon, too.”
hunks.sol: “My son would. Our Minsu is a Hunter in Bucheon, too.”

hunks.baseline: “I hear Hunters all know one another after only a degree or two. I wonder how long you’ll last if you get a bad reputation in that line of work.”
hunks.sol: “I hear all Hunters know one another through a friend or two. I wonder how long you’ll last in that line of work once word gets around about you.”

hunks.baseline: “I have a reputation for being hardworking and skilled, so I’ll be around for a long time. Happy?”
hunks.sol: “I have a reputation for being hardworking and skilled, so I’ll probably last a long time. Happy?”

hunks.baseline: “Do you know Kim Minsu? My son must be famous in Bucheon.”
hunks.sol: “Do you know Kim Minsu? My son should be famous in Bucheon.”

hunks.baseline: I answered indifferently,
hunks.sol: I answered indifferently.

hunks.baseline: “Do you know Seong Jinho? He’s the most famous person in our goshiwon.[^1]”
hunks.sol: “Do you know Seong Jinho? He’s the most famous person in our goshiwon.[^2]”

hunks.baseline: “Pfft, a goshiwon? I suppose that’s the level you’d expect from an F-rank Hunter. Is business really that bad?”
hunks.sol: “Pfft, a goshiwon? I suppose that’s the level you’d expect from an F-rank Hunter. Is your income really that pathetic?”

hunks.baseline: People always made their judgments based on the common sense they possessed.
hunks.sol: People always judged everything according to their own common sense.

hunks.baseline: “Obviously, he’s bluffing. A Hunter I know said an F-rank Hunter has to work like hell to make even a hundred million won. And did you hear him? He said he made four billion won in a single day, not in a year. It’s not like he won the lottery. Does that make any sense?”
hunks.sol: “Obviously, he’s bluffing. A Hunter I know said an F-rank Hunter has to work like hell to make even a hundred million won. And didn’t you hear him? He said he made four billion won in a single day, not in a year. It’s not like he won the lottery. Does that make any sense?”

hunks.baseline: The customers in the dining area, along with the kitchen employees who had quietly seemed to be rooting for me, began looking at me doubtfully.
hunks.sol: The customers in the dining area and even the kitchen staff, who had quietly seemed to be rooting for me, began looking at me doubtfully.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been wondering. What rank is this famous Minsu of yours? A-rank?”
hunks.sol: “I’ve been wondering about that. What rank is this famous Minsu of yours? A-rank?”

hunks.baseline: “What? Is that too high for you to believe?”
hunks.sol: “What? Are you stunned because it’s so high?”

hunks.baseline: She had sounded so confident that I had thought her son was at least Monkey D. Minsu.
hunks.sol: She had sounded so confident that I thought her son was at least Monkey D. Minsu.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps she mistook my momentary silence for shock. The owner let out a series of derisive chuckles.
hunks.sol: Perhaps she mistook my momentary silence for shock. The owner let out a series of quiet, derisive laughs.

hunks.baseline: “A D-rank Hunter like my son is the kind of person who gets respect wherever he goes. An F-rank Hunter must be too embarrassed to even admit what he does for a living.”
hunks.sol: “You have to be a D-rank Hunter like my son to get respect wherever you go. An F-rank Hunter must be too embarrassed to even admit what he does for a living.”

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t that embarrassed. I spoke just fine.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t that embarrassed. I told people just fine.”

hunks.baseline: “Personally, I think rank is everything for Hunters. What do you think, Boss?”
hunks.sol: “Personally, I agree that rank is everything among Hunters. What do you think, Boss?”

hunks.baseline: “I was F-rank. I’m C-rank now. You’re pretty slow when it comes to getting updated information.”
hunks.sol: “I was F-rank. I’m C-rank now. You’re pretty slow about updating your information.”

hunks.baseline: “I used one of those myself in the past. Lower-rank Hunters have brass-colored licenses, while mid-rank Hunters have silver ones. You didn’t know that?”
hunks.sol: “I used to carry one of those myself. Lower-rank Hunters get brass licenses, while mid-rank Hunters get silver ones. You didn’t know that?”

hunks.baseline: Suppressed laughter erupted from all around us.
hunks.sol: Suppressed laughter broke out all around us.

hunks.baseline: The atmosphere had flipped in an instant.
hunks.sol: The atmosphere had reversed in an instant.

hunks.baseline: *What kind of logic was that supposed to be?*
hunks.sol: *Was that supposed to be an argument or a fart?*

hunks.baseline: All I could do was give a hollow laugh at her absurd struggle.
hunks.sol: All I could do was laugh hollowly at her absurd struggle.

hunks.baseline: “Are titles all that matter? The company you work for matters more. People respect an assistant manager at a major corporation more than a section manager at a small company. Am I wrong?”
hunks.sol: “Is a person’s title all that matters? The company they work for matters more. People respect an Assistant Manager at a major corporation more than a section manager at a small company. Am I wrong?”

hunks.baseline: “Everyone, move tables. There’s a decent set-meal place right up ahead. I may not be an assistant manager at a major corporation, but I’m a section manager at a small business, so lunch is on me.”
hunks.sol: “Everyone, let’s eat somewhere else. There’s a decent set-meal place right up ahead. I may not be an Assistant Manager at a major corporation, but I’m a section manager at a small company, so lunch is on me.”

hunks.baseline: “Customers, that’s not what happened. Customers!”
hunks.sol: “Customers, that’s not what I meant. Customers!”

hunks.baseline: “Looking at that kitchen, it’ll take an hour anyway. Enough. We’re leaving.”
hunks.sol: “Looking at that kitchen, it’ll take an hour anyway. Forget it. We’re leaving too.”

hunks.baseline: Despite the dining staff’s attempts to stop them, the customers streamed out like the tide going out.
hunks.sol: Despite the dining staff’s attempts to stop them, the customers streamed out like the receding tide.

hunks.baseline: After barely a minute had passed, fewer than ten customers remained in the dining area.
hunks.sol: Barely a minute later, fewer than ten customers remained in the dining area.

hunks.baseline: *Damn. I can already hear the sound of this place going under.*
hunks.sol: *Damn. I can already hear this place going under.*

hunks.baseline: “So which Guild did your son say he was with?”
hunks.sol: “So which Guild did you say your son was with?”

hunks.baseline: “Were we only supposed to call each other when we had business?”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean, what is it? Are we only supposed to call each other when we have business?”

hunks.baseline: “…I sent you the promised four billion won, though.”
hunks.sol: “…I sent you the promised four billion won.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, I checked that. It came through fine.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, I checked. It came through fine.”

hunks.baseline: The entire conversation continued over speakerphone, loud enough for everyone to hear.
hunks.sol: The conversation continued over speakerphone, loud enough for everyone to hear.

hunks.baseline: The moment it became clear that what I had said earlier was true, everyone’s eyes seemed ready to pop out of their heads. I ignored all the attention and got to the point.
hunks.sol: The moment it became clear that what I had said earlier was true, everyone’s eyes nearly popped out of their heads. I ignored all the stares and got to the point.

hunks.baseline: “Kim Minsu? That’s the first I’ve heard of him.”
hunks.sol: “Kim Minsu? Never heard of him.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re a Team Leader in Sangdong Guild and you don’t even know that? They say he’s a D-rank Hunter in your Guild.”
hunks.sol: “You’re a Team Leader in Sangdong Guild, and you don’t even know him? Apparently, he’s a D-rank Hunter in your Guild.”

hunks.baseline: “D-rank Hunters are a dime a dozen. How would I know all of them? Is that why you called?”
hunks.sol: “D-rank Hunters are a dime a dozen. How am I supposed to know all of them? Is that why you called?”

hunks.baseline: Taking Im Changsoo’s business card in case he tried to stiff me had been a stroke of genius.
hunks.sol: Getting Im Changsoo’s business card in case he tried to stiff me had been a stroke of genius.

hunks.baseline: As soon as I hung up, the owner asked in a faltering voice,
hunks.sol: As soon as I hung up, the owner asked in a faltering voice.

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t you hear? He’s the Team Leader of Sangdong Guild. In simple terms, he’s Mr. Minsu’s boss.”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you hear? He’s a Team Leader in Sangdong Guild. Put simply, he’s Mr. Minsu’s boss.”

hunks.baseline: “Let’s go now.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s go.”

hunks.baseline: “Should we, son?”
hunks.sol: “Shall we, son?”

hunks.baseline: “Live like a parent should, you ajumma. Where do you get off casually running your mouth about someone else’s precious child?”
hunks.sol: “If you’re a parent, act like one and live right, you ajumma. How dare you talk about someone else’s precious child that way?”

hunks.baseline: That was the final blow.
hunks.sol: The final blow.
